verdict.rationale: First-party docs state Chroma is licensed under Apache 2.0 and can be self-hosted, and the public GitHub repository (chroma-core/chroma) is referenced. Community comments independently call it a popular OSS project with an Apache 2.0 licensed core. Missing for 10: clarity on whether Cloud-only features (e.g. distributed Cloud indexes and scaling) are also open source, since the evidence only covers the 'core'.
